extendOnlyWithAReason: Add a class or mutator only with a written reason in the PR; the lint and the lane gate fail closed on anything not listed here.

equivalenceClasses.unobservable-message: Error message text; typed kinds, not message strings, are the asserted contract.
equivalenceClasses.redundant-guard-after-typed-check: A guard the type system or an earlier check already makes unreachable, so removing it changes no behavior.
equivalenceClasses.defensive-unreachable-by-construction: A defensive branch that cannot be reached through any public input by construction.
equivalenceClasses.equivalent-arithmetic: An arithmetic or comparison change that yields the same value for every reachable input.
equivalenceClasses.platform-constant: A value fixed by the platform or a format specification, not by this code.
